title: New EU AML Regulation 2024/811
raw_content:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<RESULTS>
  <NOTICE>
    <CELEX>32024R0811</CELEX>
    <TITLE lang="EN">Regulation (EU) 2024/811 of the European Parliament and of the Council on anti-money laundering and customer due diligence requirements</TITLE>
    <DATE_DOCUMENT>2024-03-15</DATE_DOCUMENT>
    <EFFECTIVE_DATE>2024-07-01</EFFECTIVE_DATE>
    <CONTENTS>Article 1 - Scope. This regulation establishes enhanced customer due diligence requirements for credit institutions and financial undertakings. Article 2 - Definitions. Customer due diligence means the process of identifying and verifying the identity of customers and beneficial owners. Article 3 - Requirements. Financial institutions shall conduct enhanced due diligence for all customers presenting higher risk. Institutions must verify beneficial ownership and maintain records for a minimum of five years. Article 4 - Suspicious transaction reporting. Any transaction above EUR 10,000 that is suspected of being related to money laundering shall be reported to the Financial Intelligence Unit within 24 hours.</CONTENTS>
  </NOTICE>
